narrationSegments.text: Follow the rain on a kid's window backwards far enough, and you'll end up at the sea.

shots.visual: V1: Close on one raindrop sliding down a rainy window; the kid's face behind the glass, softly out of focus (POSE-RAINKID-WINDOW, curious).; V2: The drop rewinds: it slides back up the glass and lifts off into the grey sky over wet rooftops.; V3: The drop rewinds through a cloud and down to a sunlit sea, landing back in the water.

characters.action: Watches a raindrop on the glass from behind the window. Outfit OUTFIT-RAINKID-INDOOR; face FACE-RAINKID-CURIOUS.

characterMotion.action: Poses and faces swap instantly and are held at least 2 frames; the camera does most of the acting.

narrationSegments.text: You see, they're the planet's sunshade, bouncing sunlight back to space before it lands, so with fewer of them, more sun would pour onto the bare ground.
